breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states 'requiring the critical load Pcr ≥ n·P' and verifies against 62500 N (= 2.5 × 25000 N), which matches the ground truth condition P_cr ≥ n·P. The incorrect condition P_cr ≥ P/n from the incomplete prompt was not repeated.
